title: Riemann Hypothesis
description: All non-trivial zeros of the zeta function have real part half.

title: Goldbach's Conjecture
description: Every even integer greater than two is the sum of two primes.

title: Twin Prime Conjecture
description: There are infinitely many primes that differ by exactly two.

title: Collatz Conjecture
description: Repeated application of the three n plus one rule reaches one.

title: abc Conjecture
description: Relates the prime factors of numbers in addition equations.

title: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture
description: Relates the rank of an elliptic curve to its L function.

title: Beal Conjecture
description: A generalized form of Fermat's Last Theorem requiring a common prime factor.

title: Fermat's Last Theorem
description: No three positive integers satisfy the equation for powers greater than two.

title: Weak Goldbach Conjecture
description: Every odd number greater than five is the sum of three primes.

title: Green-Tao Theorem
description: The prime numbers contain arithmetic progressions of arbitrary length.

title: Catalan's Conjecture
description: Eight and nine are the only consecutive perfect powers.

title: Erdos-Straus Conjecture
description: The fraction four over n can be written using three unit fractions.

title: Legendre's Conjecture
description: There is always a prime between consecutive perfect squares.

title: Brocard's Problem
description: Finds integers whose factorial plus one equals a perfect square.

title: Littlewood Conjecture
description: Concerns simultaneous Diophantine approximation for two real numbers.

title: Elliott-Halberstam Conjecture
description: Bounds the error term in the distribution of primes in arithmetic progressions.

title: Sato-Tate Conjecture
description: Describes the statistical distribution of the number of points on elliptic curves.

title: Schanuel's Conjecture
description: Provides a unifying generalization for the transcendence of exponential expressions.

title: Lehmer's Totient Problem
description: Asks if a composite number totient divides the number minus one.

title: Carmichael's Totient Function Conjecture
description: States that no totient value is achieved by exactly one integer.

title: Odd Perfect Number Conjecture
description: Proposes that there are no odd perfect numbers.

title: Infinitude of Mersenne Primes
description: There are infinitely many primes one less than a power of two.

title: Infinitude of Fermat Primes
description: Asks whether there are infinitely many primes of the Fermat form.

title: Infinitude of Regular Primes
description: Conjectures that there are infinitely many regular prime numbers.

title: Infinitude of Sophie Germain Primes
description: Are there infinitely many primes whose double plus one is prime.

title: Infinitude of Cullen Primes
description: Asks if there are infinitely many primes of the Cullen form.

title: Infinitude of Woodall Primes
description: Asks if there are infinitely many primes of the Woodall form.

title: Infinitude of Wieferich Primes
description: Asks if there are infinitely many primes satisfying the Wieferich congruence.

title: Infinitude of Wall-Sun-Sun Primes
description: Asks if any primes satisfy a specific congruence involving Fibonacci numbers.

title: Infinitude of Wilson Primes
description: Asks if there are infinitely many primes satisfying the Wilson congruence.

title: Infinitude of Wolstenholme Primes
description: Asks if there are infinitely many primes satisfying the Wolstenholme congruence.

title: Infinitude of Wagstaff Primes
description: Asks if there are infinitely many primes of the Wagstaff form.

title: Bateman-Horn Conjecture
description: Predicts the density of primes generated by systems of polynomials.

title: Hardy-Littlewood First Tuple Conjecture
description: Quantifies the asymptotic frequency of prime constellations.

title: Hardy-Littlewood Second Conjecture
description: Claims the number of primes in intervals is subadditive.

title: Agoh-Giuga Conjecture
description: Relates prime numbers to a specific Bernoulli number congruence.

title: Erdos-Moser Equation
description: Asks if the sum of consecutive powers can equal the next power.

title: Lemoine's Conjecture
description: States every odd integer is a prime plus twice a prime.

title: Oppermann's Conjecture
description: Predicts primes closely related to squares and oblong numbers.

title: Firoozbakht's Conjecture
description: States the nth root of the nth prime is strictly decreasing.

title: Cramer's Conjecture
description: Provides an asymptotic upper bound for the gaps between consecutive primes.

title: Andrica's Conjecture
description: States the difference between square roots of consecutive primes is under one.

title: Gilbreath's Conjecture
description: Concerns the absolute differences between consecutive terms in prime sequences.

title: Polignac's Conjecture
description: States every even number is the difference of two primes infinitely often.

title: Grimm's Conjecture
description: Assigns distinct prime factors to elements of sequences of composite numbers.

title: Schinzel's Hypothesis H
description: Generalizes the twin prime conjecture to sets of irreducible polynomials.

title: Bounded Gaps Between Primes
description: Proves the existence of a finite bound for gaps between prime pairs.

title: Artin's Conjecture on Primitive Roots
description: Predicts the frequency a given integer is a primitive root modulo primes.

title: Bunyakovsky Conjecture
description: States certain irreducible polynomials yield infinitely many primes.

title: Chowla Conjecture
description: Asserts the Mobius function acts like a random coin toss.

title: Sarnak's Mobius Disjointness Conjecture
description: Relates the Mobius function to zero entropy dynamical systems.

title: Grand Riemann Hypothesis
description: Generalizes the Riemann Hypothesis to all automorphic L functions.

title: Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
description: Generalizes the Riemann Hypothesis to Dirichlet L functions.

title: Extended Riemann Hypothesis
description: Generalizes the Riemann Hypothesis to Dedekind zeta functions of algebraic number fields.

title: Lindelof Hypothesis
description: Bounds the growth of the Riemann zeta function on the critical line.

title: Montgomery's Pair Correlation Conjecture
description: Suggests zeta zeros follow the statistics of random unitary matrices.

title: Hilbert-Polya Conjecture
description: Proposes proving the Riemann Hypothesis using self adjoint operators.

title: Bloch-Kato Conjecture
description: Relates algebraic K theory to special values of L functions.

title: Fontaine-Mazur Conjecture
description: Characterizes Galois representations arising from algebraic geometry.

title: Main Conjecture of Iwasawa Theory
description: Relates ideal class groups to p adic L functions.

title: Langlands Program
description: A vast web of conjectures unifying number theory and representation theory.

title: Fundamental Lemma of the Langlands Program
description: An algebraic identity essential for proving Arthur Selberg trace formula.

title: Modularity Theorem
description: States that all rational elliptic curves arise from modular forms.

title: Serre's Modularity Conjecture
description: Relates odd irreducible Galois representations to modular forms.

title: Waring's Problem
description: Determines the minimum kth powers needed to sum to any integer.

title: Sums of Three Cubes
description: Explores which integers can be written as the sum of three cubes.

title: Euler's Sum of Powers Conjecture
description: A disproved generalization of Fermat's Last Theorem.

title: Lander-Parkin-Selfridge Conjecture
description: Predicts the minimum number of terms in sums of equal powers.

title: Giuga's Conjecture
description: Provides a criterion for primality based on a sum of powers.

title: Goormaghtigh Conjecture
description: Identifies numbers with identical repdigit representations in different bases.

title: Hall's Conjecture
description: Bounds the difference between perfect squares and perfect cubes.

title: Erdos-Woods Conjecture
description: Determines integers solely by the prime factors of adjacent intervals.

title: Szpiro's Conjecture
description: Relates the discriminant of an elliptic curve to its conductor.

title: Vojta's Conjecture
description: Generalizes the abc conjecture using Diophantine geometry.

title: Manin Conjecture
description: Describes the distribution of rational points on algebraic varieties.

title: Batyrev-Manin Conjecture
description: Extends the Manin conjecture to the distribution of points on Fano varieties.

title: Tate Conjecture
description: Relates algebraic cycles on varieties to Galois representations.

title: Congruent Number Problem
description: Asks which rational numbers are areas of right triangles with rational sides.

title: Lehmer's Mahler Measure Problem
description: Asks if the Mahler measure of integer polynomials is close to one.

title: Pisot-Vijayaraghavan Numbers Problem
description: Asks about the algebraic nature of specific Salem numbers.

title: Irrationality of the Euler-Mascheroni Constant
description: Asks whether the limiting difference between harmonic series and logarithm is irrational.

title: Irrationality of Catalan's Constant
description: Asks if the sum of the alternating inverse square series is irrational.

title: Irrationality of Apery's Constant for Odd Integers
description: Determines the irrationality of the Riemann zeta function at odd integers.

title: Irrationality of Pi plus E
description: Asks if the sum of pi and Euler's number is irrational.

title: Irrationality of Pi times E
description: Asks if the product of pi and Euler's number is irrational.

title: Normal Number Property of Pi
description: Asks if the digits of pi are uniformly distributed in all bases.

title: Normal Number Property of Root Two
description: Asks if the square root of two digits are uniformly distributed.

title: Skolem's Problem
description: Asks if a linear recurrence sequence ever contains the number zero.

title: Leopoldt's Conjecture
description: Concerns the p adic regulator of an algebraic number field.

title: Gross-Stark Conjecture
description: Relates p adic L functions to the units of number fields.

title: Stark's Conjecture
description: Evaluates Artin L functions at zero in terms of algebraic units.

title: Brumer-Stark Conjecture
description: Provides a generalization of Stickelberger's theorem to totally real fields.

title: Vandiver's Conjecture
description: States cyclotomic field maximal real subfield class numbers avoid division by p.

title: Greenberg's Conjecture
description: States that the Iwasawa mu and lambda invariants are zero.

title: Ankeny-Artin-Chowla Conjecture
description: Concerns the fundamental unit of real quadratic fields.

title: Cohen-Lenstra Heuristics
description: Predicts the statistical distribution of class groups of quadratic fields.

title: Gauss Class Number Problem for Imaginary Quadratic Fields
description: Classifies imaginary quadratic fields based on their class numbers.

title: Gauss Class Number Problem for Real Quadratic Fields
description: Asks if infinitely many real quadratic fields have class number one.

title: Existential Theory of the Rationals
description: Asks if Hilbert's tenth problem is decidable over the rational numbers.

title: Erdos Ulam Problem
description: Asks if a dense planar set can have all pairwise rational distances.

title: Erdos Squarefree Conjecture
description: States that a specific central binomial coefficient is never squarefree.

title: Cassels' Conjecture
description: Concerns the divisibility of the sum of three cubes.

title: Erdos-Graham Problem
description: Shows partitions of integers contain subsets with reciprocal sum one.

title: Mertens Conjecture
description: A disproved bound on the growth of the Mertens function.

title: Polya Conjecture
description: A disproved conjecture about the sum of the Liouville function.

title: Turan's Inequalities
description: Concerns the roots of the Riemann zeta function and related polynomials.

title: Ulam's Spiral Conjectures
description: Explains the diagonal alignments of prime numbers in a square grid.

title: Boundedness of Elliptic Curve Ranks
description: Asks whether the rank of elliptic curves is uniformly bounded.

title: Infinitude of Amicable Numbers
description: Asks whether there are infinitely many pairs of amicable numbers.

title: Singular Moduli Problem
description: Concerns algebraic differences between j invariants of elliptic curves with complex multiplication.
